# Donadomains

> Domain search aggregator that compares prices across 6 registrars in real-time. Find the cheapest place to buy any domain, or look up who owns it.

Base URL: https://donadomains.xyz
OpenAPI spec: https://donadomains.xyz/openapi.json
Full docs: https://donadomains.xyz/llms-full.txt

## When to Use This API

Use Donadomains when users want to:
- Find available domain names for a keyword, brand, or project
- Compare domain registration prices to find the cheapest registrar
- Check if a specific domain (e.g. "example.com") is available
- Look up who owns a domain, when it expires, or what registrar holds it
- Get nameservers, DNSSEC status, or RDAP data for a domain

## API — 2 Free Endpoints + 2 Paid (x402 on Starknet)

### 1. Domain Search — GET /api/search?q={keyword}

Search for domain availability and compare prices across 6 registrars (GoDaddy, Namecheap, Dynadot, Hover, Name.com, Porkbun).

Parameters:
- q (required): Keyword like "startup" or full domain like "startup.io"
- stream (optional): "true" for SSE streaming (results arrive as each registrar completes)

Response: { keyword, tld, results: [DomainResult], sources: [{ name, status, count, durationMs, error? }] }

Each DomainResult has:
- domain: "startup.com"
- available: true/false
- buyLinks: [{ name: "GoDaddy", price: "$9.99/yr", priceNum: 9.99, url: "https://...", isCheapest: true }]
- registerUrl: direct link to cheapest registrar

Tips:
- Use the JSON mode (no stream param) for simple integrations
- Filter results by available=true to get purchasable domains
- Find cheapest via: buyLinks.find(l => l.isCheapest)
- Takes 5-15 seconds (registrar scraping is the bottleneck)

### 2. Domain Info — GET /api/domain/{domain}

Detailed intelligence for a single domain. Uses RDAP + DNS-over-HTTPS.

Response includes: registered, registrar, created, expires, nameservers, status, dnssec, registrant, organization, contactEmail, sources, timing

Tips:
- Use this to check domain expiry dates (expires field)
- registrant is often "REDACTED FOR PRIVACY" when privacy protection is on
- Response time: ~1-2 seconds

### 3. Paid Search — GET /api/paid/search?q={keyword} (x402)

Same as /api/search but requires x402 payment (0.01 USDC on Starknet). No rate limits.
Returns 402 Payment Required if no payment signature is provided.
Use the `starknet-x402` npm package for automatic handling:

```
import { x402axios } from 'starknet-x402';
const result = await x402axios.get('https://donadomains.xyz/api/paid/search?q=myproject', { account, network: 'starknet-sepolia' });
```

### 4. Paid Domain Info — GET /api/paid/domain/{domain} (x402)

Same as /api/domain/{domain} but requires x402 payment (0.005 USDC on Starknet). No rate limits.

## Quick Examples

Find cheapest .com domain:
  curl "https://donadomains.xyz/api/search?q=myproject" | jq '.results[] | select(.available and .tld==".com") | {domain, cheapest: (.buyLinks[] | select(.isCheapest) | .price)}'

Check who owns a domain:
  curl "https://donadomains.xyz/api/domain/github.com" | jq '{registrar, expires, nameservers}'

## Full Reference

For complete field definitions, SSE streaming examples, and code samples in JavaScript/Python, see: https://donadomains.xyz/llms-full.txt
